title: The constant sheaf of sets with value E is represented by the disjoint union of E copies of the base
statement: Let $U$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $E$ a set. Let $U_E=\coprod_{e\in E}U$ be the coproduct of copies of $U$ indexed by $E$ [lem-weil-pbc-scheme-coproduct-family], with coprojections $\iota_e:U\to U_E$, and let $\pi:U_E\to U$ be the codiagonal, the morphism with $\pi\circ\iota_e=\mathrm{id}_U$ for all $e\in E$; regard $U_E$ as a $U$-scheme through $\pi$. Let $h_{U_E}$ be the presheaf of sets on the small etale site $U_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] given by $h_{U_E}(s:W\to U)=\operatorname{Mor}_U(W,U_E)$, restriction being composition, and let $\underline E$ be the constant sheaf of sets on $U_{\Et}$ with value $E$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], with its canonical map $\eta$ from the constant presheaf $W\mapsto E$. Then $h_{U_E}$ is a sheaf of sets on $U_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets], and the morphism of presheaves $c$ from the constant presheaf $W\mapsto E$ to $h_{U_E}$, $c_{(W,s)}(e)=\iota_e\circ s$, factors as $c=\varphi\circ\eta$ for a unique morphism of sheaves $\varphi:\underline E\to h_{U_E}$, and $\varphi$ is an isomorphism. (For $E=\varnothing$, $U_\varnothing$ is the empty scheme.)

proof.text: *Step 1 ($h_{U_E}$ is a sheaf and $c$ is a morphism of presheaves).* Regard $U_E$ as a $U$-scheme through $\pi$ [lem-weil-pbc-scheme-coproduct-family]. By [lem-weil-pbc-small-etale-representable-presheaf-sheaf] (Stacks Lemma Tag 03O3, applied with $T=U$ and $X=U_E$), the presheaf $h_{U_E}(W,s)=\operatorname{Mor}_U(W,U_E)$ is a sheaf of sets on $U_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets]. The map $c_{(W,s)}(e)=\iota_e\circ s$ lands in $\operatorname{Mor}_U(W,U_E)$ since $\pi\circ\iota_e\circ s=s$, and it is natural: for a morphism $g:(W',s')\to(W,s)$ of $U_{\Et}$ (so $s\circ g=s'$) we get $c_{(W,s)}(e)\circ g=\iota_e\circ s'=c_{(W',s')}(e)$, which is the restriction of $c_{(W,s)}(e)$ along $g$ in $h_{U_E}$ and the image of $e$ under the identity restriction map of the constant presheaf.

proof.text: Local injectivity of c. For constant elements a and b with equal represented images over W, if a=b use the maximal sieve. Otherwise use part (c) of [lem-galois-coproduct-copies-morphisms-clopen]: the preimage of the a-component for c(a) is all of W, while that for c(b) is empty. Equality of the morphisms gives top=bottom in W.Opens, so W has no points. The empty family is then an etale covering by [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], and makes the constants locally equal.

Local surjectivity of c. For a represented section f over W, part (a) of [lem-galois-coproduct-copies-morphisms-clopen] gives the open pieces V_e=f^{-1}(iota_e(U)) covering W and the identity V_e.ι ≫ f = (V_e.ι ≫ W.hom) ≫ iota_e. Open immersions are etale, and their composites with W.hom are etale by [lem-weil-pbc-etale-composition-cancellation] and [def-weil-open-immersion]. Thus Z_e=(V_e→U) are objects of the small etale site. The inclusions Z_e→W form a covering by [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], since their ranges cover W. The displayed identity says each inclusion belongs to the image sieve of f under c, so this image sieve covers. This includes an empty index set.

Construct phi using Mathlib sheafifyLift for c and the sheaf property from Step 1. Mathlib toSheafify_sheafifyLift gives eta ≫ phi.hom = c; the domain is the constant sheaf by [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf] and [def-weil-pbc-sheafification]. The sheafification unit eta is locally injective and locally surjective (Mathlib Presheaf.isLocallyInjective_toSheafify\' and isLocallySurjective_toSheafify\'). Apply Mathlib comp_isLocallyInjective_iff and comp_isLocallySurjective_iff to eta and phi.hom, and substitute the factorization: Steps 2 and 3 show phi is locally bijective. Apply [lem-galois-set-sheaf-local-bijection-isomorphism] (Mathlib Sheaf.isLocallyBijective_iff_isIso) to obtain IsIso phi. For any psi with the same factorization, sheafifyLift_unique and Sheaf.hom_ext give psi=phi. These are the standard sheafification comparison and uniqueness; the explicit second universal property and inverse construction in the old plan are unnecessary.

split_report.summary: Split along Stacks Remark 03P5 for sets (the group structure of 03P5/03YW plays no role). Step 1: h_{U_E} is an etale sheaf by lem-weil-pbc-small-etale-representable-presheaf-sheaf (03O3), c is natural. Step 2: by the new node lem-galois-coproduct-copies-morphisms-clopen (set version of 03YW: U-morphisms W -> U_E are E-indexed clopen decompositions of W), every section f is c(e) on the members of the Zariski covering {f^{-1}(V_e) -> W} (open immersions etale, lem-weil-pbc-etale-composition-cancellation); overlaps for e != e' are empty and sheaves take one value on empty objects. Step 3: (h_{U_E}, c) satisfies the universal property of the sheafification of the constant presheaf (existence by gluing alpha(e) over that covering, naturality, uniqueness). Step 4: phi exists by the universal property of eta and is an isomorphism by the two uniqueness statements. Statement unchanged. The existing lem-weil-pbc-constant-group-scheme-morphism-clopen states the 03YW bijection only for an abelian group E with the group-scheme structure, so it was not cited for a set E; lem-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf-sections-locally-constant is the abelian-group analogue (it uses lem-weil-pbc-site-sheafification-sections-local; here the universal property is checked directly, which needs no local description of sheafification). No sorry-free slopmaster2 declaration states the item (Etale.constantSheafIsoContinuousMapSheaf in WeilConjectures/Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/Sites/ConstantSheaf.lean:155 is the abelian-group, continuous-map version, not representability by U_E).

lean.statement: theorem constantSheaf_sets_representable (U : Scheme.{u}) (E : Type u) : ∃ (hH : Presheaf.IsSheaf (smallEtaleTopology U) (constantSetCoproductPresheaf U E)) (c : (Functor.const U.Etaleᵒᵖ).obj (ULift.{u + 1, u} E) ⟶ constantSetCoproductPresheaf U E), (∀ (W : U.Etale) (e : E), ((c.app (Opposite.op W)) ⟨e⟩).down.left = W.hom ≫ Sigma.ι (fun _ : E => U) e) ∧ ∃ φ : (constantSheaf (smallEtaleTopology U) (Type (max u (u + 1)))).obj (ULift.{u + 1, u} E) ⟶ ⟨constantSetCoproductPresheaf U E, hH⟩, (toSheafify (smallEtaleTopology U) ((Functor.const U.Etaleᵒᵖ).obj (ULift.{u + 1, u} E))) ≫ φ.hom = c ∧ IsIso φ ∧ ∀ ψ : (constantSheaf (smallEtaleTopology U) (Type (max u (u + 1)))).obj (ULift.{u + 1, u} E) ⟶ ⟨constantSetCoproductPresheaf U E, hH⟩, (toSheafify (smallEtaleTopology U) ((Functor.const U.Etaleᵒᵖ).obj (ULift.{u + 1, u} E))) ≫ ψ.hom = c → ψ = φ
